headline: Property names dominate the mover list, with sharp declines in A, PF and EVER and heavy volume in S, while TRITN and GEL recorded extreme one-day moves on thin trade.
market_take: Coverage is split, with sharp downside in TRITN, A, PF, EVER and PLE alongside strong gains in GEL, VPO, CIVIL and several property names. Trading is thin behind the most extreme moves: TRITN fell -33.33% on vol×0.01 and GEL rose +33.33% on vol×0.09. Alert volume is elevated at 48, including large volume spikes in S, TNPF and MNRF. DRT filed reviewed Q3/2026 results and statements on 11 Nov 2026.

sector_notes.note: A fell -28.67% on vol×0.21, while PF and EVER each fell -20.00%; AMATA rose +9.71% and WHA +7.44%. S rose +8.16% with a 13.3σ volume spike, and CIVIL also recorded a 5.2σ volume spike.
CIVIL rose +10.59% on vol×4.13 with a 5.2σ volume spike, while PLE fell -16.67% and TRITN -33.33%. TRITN and PLE both opened with sharp price gaps.
MADAME rose +7.50% on vol×6.06, with a 4.3σ volume spike and a +6.61% intraday move. SORKON filed reviewed Q3/2026 results and statements on 10 Nov 2026.
VPO rose +11.43% on vol×2.53 and was flagged for a +11.43% intraday move.
GEL rose +33.33% on vol×0.09 with a +33.33% open gap. DRT filed reviewed Q3/2026 financial performance, statements and MD&A on 11 Nov 2026.
TNPF recorded a 21.8σ volume spike and MNRF an 8.8σ spike, the largest alerts among the REIT names shown. SSTRT and HYDROGEN filed reviewed Q3/2026 results.
